title: DAY 12/90
WEEK 2 TEST
scenes.sub: Beams, shafts and words: prove it tonight
scenes.voice: Day twelve of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, ninety eight days to go! Let's check how much of week two really stuck.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: No new chapter today. It is week two revision: four strength of materials topics and one verbal ability topic, all in one test.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Revise shear force and bending moment diagrams with bending stress, beam deflection, torsion with cylinders and springs, and verbal ability. Rework every question you missed.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Spring stiffness is G d to the fourth over eight D cubed n. Halve the coil diameter, stiffness jumps eight times. Halve the turns, it only doubles.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free week two practice set with full solutions is on Telegram now. Tonight's weekly test, twenty questions, opens seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 11 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day eleven toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo takes rank one with twenty eight out of thirty. Atharva Vyas returns at rank two, and Akshay W holds rank three. Congratulations!
